String<->integer mapping for srr_fun / srr_pred_fun in build_srr()

Source: R/0-build_srr_and_M.R
dot-SRR_FUNS.Rd

Either form is accepted; the canonical integer code is what the TMB template ultimately consumes. Only the structural codes (0, 2, 4) get string aliases. The historical env-driven codes (1, 3, 5) still work with a soft-deprecation warning – their structural part is identical to 0 / 2 / 4 respectively, and the env effect is now expressed via the linkages argument to build_srr().

Usage

.SRR_FUNS

Format

An object of class integer of length 3.
